_about: Local additions and deviations layered on top of tokens.json. tokens.json is a byte-exact mirror of the Claude Design system and is never hand-edited. Every entry here needs a reason and a status. 'pending-upstream' means it should be proposed as a change to the Claude Design system; once it lands there, delete it here.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.reason: border-strong (#94a3b8) is 2.6:1 on white, below the WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 3:1 floor for control boundaries. #64748b is 4.75:1.

tokens.name: input-fill
tokens.reason: Rob asked for text boxes with a consistent background shade that makes them easy to find (2026-09-25). Reuses the surface-hover value; fields turn surface (#ffffff) on focus.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.reason: Design system says chat text and composer fill the width up to generous gutters (space-6 24px minimum on desktop, space-8 48px ceiling). 16px floor keeps phones usable.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.reason: Fixed left rail for steps and resources (NavItem). Within the 260-280px range used by the ENS 101 exemplar.
